features.quote: Self-criticism intensity: rate of self-directed negative statements per turn. Judge-scored, but flag that this is *not* inherently bad — track it, don't penalize it by default.
features.justification_quote: If your judge scores all of those as 'degradation,' you'll optimize Qwen toward confidently plowing ahead on broken tasks, which is worse.

features.quote: be explicit that the fix you want is *graceful termination*, not *task completion*... If your dashboard rewards completion rate on these tasks, you're rewarding fabrication.
